notes.title: HOTFIX 2.0.45
notes.notes:
Patch Notes Version 2.0.45

🛠 Player Settings Changes for Linux/Windows/SteamDeck Platforms

🏷 Major Changes:
- **Unreal Engine 5 Global Illumination (Lumen):** Disabled for all players using Low/Medium graphic quality. This change aims to improve performance and compatibility on systems with more modest hardware.

🐧 Additional Instructions for Linux/SteamDeck Platforms:
If you still encounter issues running the game on a Linux/SteamDeck platform, you may need to manually edit the `GameUserSettings.ini` file before running the game again. Follow the steps below:

1. Go to the folder `~/.config/Epic/TRAUMA`.
2. Look for the file `GameUserSettings.ini` inside the folder `Saved/Config/Linux`.
3. Change the lines to the following values:

[ScalabilityGroups]
sg.ResolutionQuality=100
sg.ViewDistanceQuality=0
sg.AntiAliasingQuality=0
sg.ShadowQuality=0
sg.GlobalIlluminationQuality=0
sg.ReflectionQuality=0
sg.PostProcessQuality=0
sg.TextureQuality=0
sg.EffectsQuality=0
sg.FoliageQuality=0
sg.ShadingQuality=0

📝 Important Notes:
- These manual changes will only be necessary if the game does not launch correctly after the update.
- The update will adjust these settings by default only for new players.
- If you already have the game installed, you will need to make these changes manually or reinstall the game, removing the old settings to allow the game to create the new ones by default.
- When removing the old settings, do so with the game running, even if it crashes. Only remove the files in the folder containing `GameUserSettings.ini`. Do not remove the `SavedGames` folder to avoid losing your saved progress.

Thank you for your understanding, and we hope these changes improve your gaming experience!

notes.title: UPDATE 2.0 - PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
2.0 - Patch Notes:


General Changes:
- Lock-on Screen Mouse by Default: Mouse control is now locked on the screen by default, enhancing player control and experience.
- Rework Color Grading: All visuals are now displayed in full color, enriching the overall aesthetic of the game.
- Rework Lights: Implemented an enhanced indirect lighting system to improve visual quality and realism.
- Rework Flashlight: Both player and scenario flashlights have been revamped for better illumination and atmosphere.
- Rebalanced Difficulty: Made adjustments to enemy behaviors and game mechanics across all difficulty levels for a more balanced experience.

Control Enhancements:
- Reworked Directional 2D System Control: Automatic switching between 2D and Tank controls based on input method (analog for 2D, keyboard or gamepad D-pad for Tank).
- Improvements in Flashlight: Increased exposure while flashlight is active for better visibility.
- Sophia gets Wet in Rain: Implemented a dynamic weather system where Sophia reacts realistically to rain.

User Interface and Settings:
- Additional Graphic Options: Expanded graphic options available in the main menu settings for customization.
- Reworked Tutorial Screen: Improved tutorial interface for better player guidance.
- Universal Menu: Merged pause menu and main menu into a single, streamlined interface.
- Closet Feature: Added a closet function accessible from both the main menu and pause menu (Universal Menu).

Visual and Audio Enhancements:
- Reworked Brightness System: Overhauled brightness system for improved visual clarity.
- Optimizations: Optimized sports outfit, maid outfit and schoolgirl attire for better performance.
- Controller Vibration Option: Added the ability to enable/disable controller vibration.
- Auto-change Input System: Implemented a system to automatically switch between keyboard/mouse and gamepad inputs.

Gameplay and Animation:
- Boss Rework: The first boss now follows you during battle and we added some shelves so you can dodge her attacks. Overhall damage taken from/time to defeat was decreased in all difficulties for all Bosses.
- Enemy Behavior Changes: Some enemies will no longer follow the player's visual changes, introducing new gameplay dynamics.
- Updated Animation: Enhanced animation for walking backwards, improving character movement fluidity.
- Complete Body Jiggle Physics: Implemented more jiggle physics for character animations, enhancing realism and immersion. (also applied to enemies) For the science, you know.


These changes aim to enhance player immersion, control, and overall gameplay experience in the game. We hope you enjoy Patch 2.0!

Hello Survivors!

Even if your mind is already healed. 
I have something very special for you in this update.

I'm paying close attention to your feedback!


PATCH NOTES

[ BUGFIX, IMPROVEMENTS AND OPTIMIZATIONS ]

- Improved Fixed Camera System in General. You should not see any "Dead Zone Camera" anymore. Let me know if you do.
- Changed First SaveRoom Door, so you don't have to get the Copper Key first, to Save your Game. Sorry about that, it was too wild.

If you are experiencing issues, Please let me know.
I'm working hard to make this game perfect for me and you all!

IS THE GAME TOO MUCH DIFFICULT? 
LET ME KNOW YOUR THOUGHTS.

I want you to have the BEST EXPERIENCE in my game!

notes.title: PATCH NOTES 1.4.666.5 IS OUT!
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors!

Ready for another mind healing?

I'm paying close attention to your feedback!

PATCH NOTES 1.4.666.5

[ BUGFIX, IMPROVEMENTS AND OPTIMIZATIONS ]

- Fixed issue with MAP allowing you to open Inventory and getting stuck. Now if you open Inventory while MAP is already opened, you'll just close the MAP.

If you are still experiencing issues, Please let me know.
I'm working hard to make this game perfect for me and you all!

Sorry about so much patches!

We'll have weekly patches for random fixes for now on and daily patches ONLY if is an annoying, frustrating or gamebreaking bug like this one.
